SELECT FROM sys_flow_task t
AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND t.status = 0 AND (t.assignee IS NULL OR t.assignee = '') AND (
( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_flow_task_candidate tc WHERE tc.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND tc.task_id = t.task_id AND tc.candidate_type = 'USER' AND tc.candidate_value = #{userId} AND tc.status = 1 ) OR ( t.candidate_users IS NOT NULL AND t.candidate_users != '' AND FIND_IN_SET( REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{userId}, ';', ','), '；', ','), '，', ','), ' ', ''), REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.candidate_users, ';', ','), '；', ','), '，', ','), '、', ','), ' ', '') ) > 0 ) )
OR
( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_flow_task_candidate tc WHERE tc.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND tc.task_id = t.task_id AND tc.candidate_type = 'GROUP' AND tc.candidate_value = #{groupId} AND tc.status = 1 ) OR ( t.candidate_groups IS NOT NULL AND t.candidate_groups != '' AND FIND_IN_SET( REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{groupId}, ';', ','), '；', ','), '，', ','), ' ', ''), REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.candidate_groups, ';', ','), '；', ','), '，', ','), '、', ','), ' ', '') ) > 0 ) )
1 = 0
)
AND t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC

SELECT t.*, m.category AS category, c.category_name AS category_name, m.model_name AS process_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.model_name, ''), NULLIF(task_procdef.NAME_, '')) AS process_definition_name FROM sys_flow_task t
LEFT JOIN sys_flow_category c ON c.id = m.category WHERE t.due_date IS NOT NULL AND t.due_date <= #{now} AND t.status IN (0, 1) ORDER BY t.due_date ASC, t.create_time ASC

AND (t.status = 0 OR (t.assignee = #{userId} AND t.status = 1))
